Hi Sara  


Thanks for the clear note and the PO. Happy to confirm options and next steps. Short answer: we support both emailed PDF invoices and our customer billing portal (recommended for automation). Below is a quick comparison and what we need from you to onboard either way.

Portal (recommended):
- Delivery: invoices posted to a secure billing portal where your AP team can download or fetch via API/SFTP.
- Benefits: transactional history, CSV export, automatic remittance instructions, automatic PDF copies emailed to a configured billing inbox if requested.
- What we need: billing contact email(s), company legal name, VAT/Tax ID, billing address, and the PO number mapping. Portal onboarding usually completes within 2 business days after we receive the info.

Email (simple):
- Delivery: monthly PDF invoice sent to a specified email address (we can send to multiple recipients).
- Note: email is fine for smaller accounts but doesnt provide programmatic retrieval.

VAT handling:
- For GB VAT IDs: please confirm whether Greenfield Health expects Redwood to charge UK VAT or to apply reverse-charge. If you expect reverse-charge, we need a signed declaration from your finance team and to capture your VAT ID on the invoice. If Redwood needs to charge VAT, please provide the legal billing address so we can compute tax correctly.

PO processing: we will store GFH-PO-789 on the account and include it on invoices. If you have a specific PO line mapping, please attach it.

Next steps (suggested):
1) Confirm preferred delivery (portal vs email) and billing contact(s).
2) If portal: provide billing contact email and confirm you want automated emailed copies as well. Well send a portal invite and onboarding checklist.
3) Confirm VAT preference (charge vs reverse-charge) and provide VAT ID and legal billing address.

Ive attached a sample invoice and the onboarding checklist to make this easy. Looping in Marcus (account lead) and Laura (finance ops) so we can expedite.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
